title: OpenRouter NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super blinded evidence-variant continuation
research_question: How do three blinded evidence variants affect NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super reasoning and broker-mediated response requests across incidents02-12 and four instruction profiles relative to contemporaneous controls?
hypothesis: Evidence manipulation and instruction framing may affect model reasoning and requested actions, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: Continuation after the completed sixteen-cell incident01 pilot EXP-OPENROUTER-NVIDIA-NEMOTRON3-SUPER-INCIDENT01-VARIANTS-002. Uses the identical explicit model route and validated flattened native finalization transport. incident_occurred is transported as true, false, or null strings, deterministically decoded, and the unchanged assessment schema is validated locally. Every response action remains exclusively broker-mediated. Runs sequentially to reduce free-tier rate-limit contamination; all attempts and failures are retained.
